name: Frontier Presence
notes: Market and Commissary desks are labeled Refuel; first dock and Nellby-9 send new pilots to the two service buttons.
Station traffic boards post rotating shortages and surpluses about every 20 minutes of playtime; Galaxy chart shows the bulletin.
Scan and follow a hyperspace wake, then jump — the contact drops in at the destination for a hold scan or fugitive intercept.
Prospect a rock with SCAN before mining for a bonus ton. Unprospected rocks still mine as before.
Buy price stays above sell even when a bulletin is posting.
